findings.title: Verify consistent gating and descriptions coverage
findings.description: Two products (001 and 003) now use `testWebsites`, but product-002 (line 115) still uses a hard-coded array. Additionally, when `includeTestSites=true`, products 001 and 003 will be assigned to both `shiekh.com` and `shiekhshoes.com`, but their `descriptions` objects only contain entries for `shiekh.com`.
questions: 1. Is the exclusion of product-002 from the gating intentional, or should it also use `testWebsites` for consistency?
2. Does the system handle products assigned to websites that lack corresponding description entries? This could cause validation failures or display issues.
